# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project

Research project running a 28.9M-parameter language model on an ESP32-S3 (~$8 chip) at ~9.5 tok/s. The key idea is applying Google's Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE) technique to the microcontroller memory hierarchy, leaving a 25M-param lookup table in flash and keeping only the 559K-param "thinking" core in fast SRAM.

## Commands

### Python (model training and export)

```bash
# Install dependencies
uv sync

# Prepare dataset (downloads TinyStories, trains BPE tokenizer, emits .bin files)
uv run python data/prepare.py

# Train a model
uv run python src/train.py

# Export trained checkpoint to firmware/model/model.bin + golden.txt
cd src && uv run python export.py

# Sample from a checkpoint
uv run python src/sample.py

# Post-training quantization check
uv run python src/quantize.py
```

### Firmware (ESP32-S3, Arduino ESP32 core 3.3.10)

```bash
# Host-side C verifier (run after export to confirm C runtime matches PyTorch)
cc -O3 -o /tmp/esp32-llm-verify firmware/host_verify/verify.c -lm
/tmp/esp32-llm-verify firmware/model/model.bin firmware/model/golden.txt

# Compile firmware
arduino-cli compile \
  --fqbn 'esp32:esp32:esp32s3:UploadSpeed=921600,USBMode=hwcdc,CDCOnBoot=cdc,UploadMode=default,CPUFreq=240,FlashMode=qio,FlashSize=16M,PartitionScheme=custom,PSRAM=opi,DebugLevel=info' \
  --build-property compiler.optimization_flags=-O3 \
  --build-path /tmp/esp32-llm-build \
  firmware/esp32_llm

# Flash firmware (adjust port as needed)
arduino-cli upload \
  -p /dev/cu.usbmodem2101 \
  --fqbn 'esp32:esp32:esp32s3:UploadSpeed=921600,USBMode=hwcdc,CDCOnBoot=cdc,UploadMode=default,CPUFreq=240,FlashMode=qio,FlashSize=16M,PartitionScheme=custom,PSRAM=opi,DebugLevel=info' \
  --input-dir /tmp/esp32-llm-build \
  firmware/esp32_llm

# Flash model binary to its own partition (only needed after a new export)
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/cu.usbmodem2101 --baud 921600 \
  write_flash 0x110000 firmware/model/model.bin

# Monitor serial output
arduino-cli monitor -p /dev/cu.usbmodem2101 --config baudrate=115200
```

## Architecture

### Memory hierarchy

The model is split across three memory tiers by access pattern:

| Tier | Memory | Size | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| core | SRAM (fast) | 512 KB | Dense transformer core, ~559K params |
| stream | PSRAM (medium) | 8 MB | Output head (staged int8), scratch buffers, ~3.1M params |
| table | Flash (slow, huge, XIP mmap'd) | 16 MB | PLE lookup table, ~25M params; ~6 rows (~450 B) read per token |

Flash is memory-mapped via `esp_partition_mmap` — the table is never bulk-loaded. The output head is unpacked once at boot from int4 to int8 in PSRAM (`stage_head_int8`), then stays there. Everything else is allocated in PSRAM with `heap_caps_malloc(MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM)`.

### Model arms (ablation variants)

`src/model.py` defines five variants controlled by `Config.arm`:

- `ple` — full model, PLE gate injected at every layer from the flash table (the main result)
- `baseline` — standard tiny LM, no table, core-only (lower-bound reference)
- `ple_notable` — PLE plumbing but no table lookup (isolates plumbing overhead)
- `fatembed` — same table budget as `ple` but injected only at layer 0 (per-layer vs. bottom-only control)
- `bigcore` — spends the table budget on a wider dense core (upper-bound reference)

The deploy config is: `vocab_size=32768, d_model=96, n_layers=6, n_heads=4, ffn_hidden=66, ple_dim=128`.

### Transformer internals

- RMSNorm (no bias), split-half RoPE, SwiGLU FFN (`gate`/`up`/`down`)
- PLE gate per layer: `x += RMSNorm(ple_proj(gelu(ple_gate(x)) * ple_l))`
- Tied input embedding / output head (weight sharing)

### Data flow: training → device

1. `data/prepare.py` → `data/train.bin`, `data/val.bin`, `data/tokenizer.json`
2. `src/train.py` → `runs/<name>.pt` checkpoint
3. `src/export.py` → `firmware/model/model.bin` (ragged int4, group-128, fp16 scales; magic `PLE1`) + `firmware/model/golden.txt` (reference logits)
4. `firmware/host_verify/verify.c` — validates the C runtime against golden before flashing
5. `arduino-cli compile` + `arduino-cli upload` → firmware partition
6. `esptool.py write_flash 0x110000` → model partition

`vocab.h` (token-to-bytes lookup for the firmware) is generated by `src/gen_assets.py` and is gitignored; regenerate it from the tokenizer before compiling.

### Single-header C runtime (`firmware/common/llm.h`)

Portable C inference used by both `firmware/host_verify/` (for golden comparison) and `firmware/esp32_llm/` (on-device). Key structures: `Cfg`, `QT` (quantized tensor view), `Model`, `Scratch`. `llm_load` parses the binary and binds tensors in-place via mmap; `llm_forward` runs one decode step. Compile with `-DLLM_INT8_ACT` to switch to the int8-activation matvec path (used on device for the output head).

### Flash partition layout

```
factory   app    0x010000   1 MB     compiled sketch
model     data   0x110000  ~15 MB    model.bin (14.9 MB at 4-bit)
coredump  data   0xFF0000  64 KB
```

Defined in `firmware/esp32_llm/partitions.csv`. The model partition only needs reflashing after a new export; firmware-only changes can be uploaded independently.
